Landslides and Flooding Hit India Amidst Heavy Monsoon Rains

Heavy monsoon rains have caused significant incidents across India, including a deadly landslide in Wayanad, Kerala, and severe waterlogging and infrastructure failures in Pune, Maharashtra. The Wayanad landslide resulted in multiple fatalities and missing persons, with construction at a twin-tunnel site cited as a factor. In Pune, newly built roads and a disaster management center have come under scrutiny following widespread flooding.
